_comment: Ground truth for VTC evaluation on Jenkins perfecto-plugin. CVE-2020-2261 — OS Command Injection: build configuration fields concatenated into bash -c invocation.

CVE-2020-2261/PerfectoBuildWrapper.java.vulnerability: OS Command Injection via Perfecto Connect launch parameters

true_positives.description: getTunnelId() parameter perfectoConnectLocation (from job config) -> string concatenation into bash -c -> Runtime.getRuntime().exec(cmdArgs). True sink is the exec argument `cmdArgs`. NOTE: the LLM currently terminates the chain one hop earlier at the command string `baseCommand`, so this is a known FN until Stage-1 labels the exec argument as the sink. We do NOT move the goalpost to `baseCommand` — the honest sink is the exec call.
